message.content: {"items":[{"title":"European Working Conditions Survey 2010","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.10986","justification":"Pan-European survey on working conditions conducted around 2010, including many of the requested countries (EU member states and several associated countries). Covers a broad set of working condition indicators across the early 2010s."},{"title":"European Working Conditions Survey 2015","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12660","justification":"2015 wave of the European Working Conditions Survey with extensive coverage of EU and some non-EU European countries, directly focused on working conditions in the mid-2010s."},{"title":"International Social Survey Programme: Work Orientations IV – ISSP 2015","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12648","justification":"ISSP Work Orientations module focusing on attitudes toward work, job conditions, and employment in 2015. Many of the listed European countries participate, allowing analysis of perceived working conditions in the 2010s."},{"title":"International Social Survey Programme: Work Orientations III – ISSP 2005 and 2010 Cumulation","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.11749","justification":"Cumulated ISSP Work Orientations modules for 2005 and 2010. The 2010 component provides information on work-related conditions and attitudes close to the start of the 2010s in multiple European countries."},{"title":"European Company Survey 2013","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.11988","justification":"Survey of establishments across Europe focusing on workplace practices, work organization, and working conditions. Conducted in 2013 and includes many of the listed countries."},{"title":"European Company Survey 2019","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13472","justification":"Late-2010s establishment-level survey examining workplace practices, employee representation, and working conditions across a wide range of European countries."},{"title":"European Social Survey Round 5 (2010)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.11473","justification":"General social survey with multiple items on employment, job security, work autonomy, and related aspects, fielded in 2010 across many of the specified European countries."},{"title":"European Social Survey Round 6 (2012)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12274","justification":"2012 ESS round, covering numerous European countries, includes variables on employment status, job quality aspects, and work–life balance relevant to working conditions in the early 2010s."},{"title":"European Social Survey Round 7 (2014)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12273","justification":"2014 ESS wave with broad European coverage, providing data on employment conditions, job satisfaction, and related indicators for the mid-2010s."},{"title":"European Social Survey Round 8 (2016)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12628","justification":"2016 ESS wave covering many European and associated countries; includes variables on employment, contract type, working hours, and other elements of working conditions in the second half of the 2010s."}]}
